test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who studies insects.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Entomologist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • An **Entomologist** is a scientist who studies insects, their behavior, classification, and ecology. (कीटविज्ञानी) • **Example:** The entomologist spent hours observing the ants' social behavior in their natural habitat. • A **Zoologist** studies animals, their classification, behavior, and ecosystems. (जीवविज्ञानी) • **Example:** A zoologist may specialize in studying marine animals like dolphins and whales. • A **Botanist** specializes in the study of plants, including their physiology, structure, and ecology. (वनस्पतिविज्ञानी) • **Example:** The botanist discovered a new species of flowering plants in the rainforest. • A **Pathologist** focuses on the study of diseases, their causes, and effects on the human body. (रोगविज्ञानी) • **Example:** The pathologist examined the tissue samples to determine the cause of the illness. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Entomologist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the remaining options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Zoologist** (जीवविज्ञानी): A scientist who studies animals and their behavior in their natural habitats. • **Example:** The zoologist published a groundbreaking paper on lion conservation. • **Botanist** (वनस्पतिविज्ञानी): A person who studies plants and their interaction with the environment. • **Example:** The botanist’s research contributed to the understanding of plant growth in arid climates. • **Pathologist** (रोगविज्ञानी): A medical expert who examines diseases and the changes they cause in tissues or organs. • **Example:** The pathologist identified the unusual cell growth as a sign of cancer. 1b9:T91e, The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Amateur**.
